hero.description: I'm Jonathan — a Software Engineer and Founder based in Ecuador. I build software that's technically rigorous, obsessively polished, and shaped around the people who use it.

about.label: 01 — About
about.headline:
I build software
that matters.
about.quote: Software becomes indispensable when it respects the intelligence of the person using it.
bio: From the Andes of Ecuador to the frontier of modern software engineering — I've been driven by a conviction that code is a craft, not just a technical exercise.

I spent five years at <epn>Escuela Politécnica Nacional</epn> earning a Software Engineering degree — building in parallel: hardening security at Fextor, delivering operational tools for the Ecuadorian Army, and now shipping production software at <sb>Stack Builders</sb>.
I care deeply about the full stack — clean architectures, thoughtful APIs, interfaces that feel effortless. Every commit is an opportunity to make something a little more right.
When I'm not coding, I'm thinking about products: why some software becomes indispensable while most fades away. That question drives everything I build.

experience.label: 02 — Experience
experience.headline: Where I've worked.
experience.subtitle: Three roles across security, military tech, and product engineering — each one sharpening a different dimension of the craft.

items.description: Currently serving as tech lead on the Okta project — leading DevRel microsites and maintaining developer tools like jwt.io for millions of developers worldwide. Previously led frontend development on Twilio's One Twilio rebranding initiative, migrating a large-scale AEM component library across three product lines.

Served as tech lead, overseeing the design and delivery of internal systems for the Ecuadorian Army. Built a database audit framework to ensure data integrity across critical Army records, and led the migration of internal tools at the SIPER department (Sistema de Personal de la Fuerza Terrestre).

Conducted digital forensics investigations and network traffic analysis to identify and contain security incidents. Automated security monitoring with custom tooling, and assessed and patched critical infrastructure vulnerabilities.

skills.label: 03 — Skills
skills.headline: Tools of the trade.
skills.subtitle: Technologies I reach for when building products that need to scale, perform, and last.

items.name: Okta
items.subtitle: Auth0 Developer Relations — Microsite Maintenance & Legacy Migration
items.description: Lead engineering for Auth0's Developer Relations team at Okta — maintaining Next.js microsites, migrating legacy web properties to modern stacks, and keeping tools like jwt.io serving millions of developers worldwide.

highlights.label: DevRel Microsites
highlights.description: Maintain and develop Next.js microsites for the Auth0 Developer Relations team — ensuring performance, content accuracy, and a consistent developer experience across properties including jwt.io.

highlights.label: Legacy Modernization
highlights.description: Migrate legacy web properties from outdated architectures to modern Next.js, improving build times, scalability, and long-term maintainability across the Auth0 web ecosystem.

items.name: CertiConsulty
items.subtitle: Occupational Safety & Health Consulting — Ecuador
items.description: Co-founded CertiConsulty — an occupational safety and health consulting company helping Ecuadorian businesses achieve full compliance with Ministry of Labor regulations. Led company vision, product design, and go-to-market strategy, and assembled a certified, multidisciplinary team with national coverage.

highlights.label: Vision & Strategy
highlights.description: Defined the company mission and go-to-market strategy for Ecuador's occupational safety consulting market, positioning CertiConsulty as a compliance-first, practical alternative to traditional providers.

highlights.label: Product & Operations
highlights.description: Built the service offering — structured training programs, SENESCYT-validated certifications, SUT registration workflows, and a consulting model that scales across industries.

items.name: Twilio
items.subtitle: One Twilio Rebranding — Component Migration & Web Experience
items.description: Worked across two cross-functional teams at Twilio to drive the One Twilio rebranding initiative — migrating the AEM component library and unifying the web presence of Twilio, Segment, and SendGrid under a single design system.

workstreams.description: Migrated AEM components to the One Twilio rebranding, unifying Segment and SendGrid components into a single cohesive design language across the entire platform.
Migrated hundreds of pages to the new design system via the AEM authoring view. Resolved component-level bugs and improved the authoring and end-user experience.
